first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, directly matching the lever that memory_86 and memory_31 both validated. Memory_86 showed shortening onboarding lifted completion rates and time-to-value across self-serve; memory_31 demonstrated that signup field reduction specifically improved SMB activation. Both are directly applicable to the current drop. Verifying memory_86 ensures the onboarding completion mechanism remains valid in current product context. Memory_73 verification is secondary but addresses the competitive pressure on price-sensitive SMB—if promotional pricing proves less durable than onboarding simplification, onboarding becomes the stronger move. Activation drop (6%) is larger than onboarding drop (4%), but activation_messaging addresses symptom; simplify_onboarding addresses root cause of time-to-value friction that likely drives both metrics. Enterprise_sales_assist targets high-LTV customers but does not address the SMB segment being hit by competitor pricing. Referral_incentive requires healthy activation baseline first. Standard_experiment scale allows measurement confidence while preserving optionality if results signal need for subsequent pricing response.
